messages:
Priya: Heads-up planning thread for next Tue marketplace launch. Proposed micro-timing: 08:55 PT infra heads-up, 09:00 PT landing cutover, 09:04 PT press release (tech outlets), 09:10 PT broader press, 09:15 PT blog, 09:25 PT partner emails. Any red flags?
Liam: Sounds good. Can we push press to 09:04 so tech reviewers get immediate access then broader outlets at :10?
Ava: Marketing agrees to 09:04/09:10 split. Need a 5m heads-up before cutover to queue socials.
Noah: Ops can do 08:55 preflight and smoke. Recommend a temporary throttle on catalog ingestion for the first 20m to avoid spikes.
Marta: ApexEdge and FalconRack confirmed hero assets and standby. ApexEdge wants dark-mode sprite ready; uploading to the partner assets folder now.
Priya: Listing IDs for press copy? Need exact marketplace IDs to include.
Marta: Listing IDs: mkp-APX-2026 (ApexEdge), mkp-FRK-888 (FalconRack). Added to the shared note.
Priya: SI partners IntegralSI/AtlasWorks need early provisioning. @Noah can you expose test endpoints and keys?
Noah: Service accounts created, test endpoints live by 08:20 PT. KV warm sweep scheduled 08:30 PT.
Liam: Legal check: we cannot name customer quotes without explicit approval. legal-bot, any ETA?
legal-bot: Legal has a 4hr SLA for launch quotes. File submitted; expect response EOD.
Ava: Blog plan: quick lead, 3 partner callouts, tech sidebar about latency and batching. Need final copy by EOD for press review.
Priya: Deploy-bot, please pin the runbook at cutover and set channel topic.
deploy-bot: Runbook pinned: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-launch-quickrun; topic set.
Noah: I'll set autoscale cap to 130% baseline for first 20m and monitor token/latency metrics.
Priya: Partner comms: we'll send partner-facing email at 09:25 PT. Marta, partners standing by to swap hero if needed at cutover?
Marta: Yes, partners on standby. We have dark-mode and light-mode variants ready.
Ava: Support prep: adding three canned replies for pricing, onboarding ETA, and data residency to the runbook so CS can copy-paste.
Liam: PR targeting timeline: tech outlets 09:04, trade press 09:10, business press 09:20. I'll distribute embargo list accordingly.
Priya: Final minute checklist: 
- 08:00 PT full preflight 
- 08:20 PT SI smoke endpoints 
- 08:30 PT KV warm sweep 
- 08:55 PT infra heads-up 
- 09:00 PT landing cutover 
- 09:04 PT press release (tech) 
- 09:10 PT press release (general) 
- 09:15 PT blog publish 
- 09:25 PT partner email 
Please react with :white_check_mark: if aligned or flag blockers now.
Liam: :white_check_mark:
Noah: :white_check_mark:
Ava: :white_check_mark:
Marta: :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks all, I'll post the minute-by-minute runbook 1hr before launch in this channel.
